S7 Classes for the Shipped Intervals and Predictive Distributions

Source: R/predict_objects.R
ConfidenceInterval-class.Rd

These are the classes that confidence_interval(), group_interval(), prediction_interval(), pred_averaged(), pred_plugin() and pred_bootstrap() instantiate. ConfidenceInterval, GroupInterval and PredictionInterval inherit from interval_type(); PredAveraged, PredPlugin and PredBootstrap inherit from predictive_type(). PredictionInterval adds the property predictive, and PredBootstrap adds n and refit. Use the constructors, which validate; these raw ones do not.

Usage

ConfidenceInterval(label = character(0))

GroupInterval(label = character(0))

PredictionInterval(label = character(0), predictive = predictive_type())

PredAveraged(label = character(0))

PredPlugin(label = character(0))

PredBootstrap(label = character(0), n = integer(0), refit = character(0))

Arguments

label

A single string, the name that the object prints.

predictive

A predictive_type(). Only PredictionInterval carries this property.

n, refit

The number of replicas and the refit mode. Only PredBootstrap carries these properties.

Value

An S7 object inheriting from interval_type() or from predictive_type(), with the properties listed above.

See also

predict_intervals, predictive_distributions for the constructors side by side.
